user.title: Add GeekMagic Display
user.description: Enter the IP address, hostname, or URL of your GeekMagic device. Examples: 192.168.1.100, geekmagic.local:8080. Prefix with https:// for secure connections.

pro_managed_album.title: SmallTV Pro Picture Album
pro_managed_album.description: SmallTV Pro Picture mode is a slideshow. To show Home Assistant dashboards reliably, GeekMagic needs exclusive control of the Picture album: it will delete existing pictures on this device and keep only one managed dashboard image. Back up any pictures you want to keep before continuing. After setup, manually select the Picture app on the device; the integration will not press the device menu buttons automatically.

data.manage_pro_album: I understand GeekMagic will delete existing Pro album pictures and keep one managed dashboard image

reconfigure.title: Move GeekMagic Display
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address, hostname, or URL of your GeekMagic device. Screens, widgets and entity IDs are preserved.

error.confirm_required: You must confirm album management before adding this Pro device.

error.dns_error: Could not resolve hostname. Check the address is correct.
error.http_error: Device responded with an error. It may be running incompatible firmware.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while connecting.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The display is now configured at its new address.
